<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the base peak is at m/z 235.1395, which corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 234.132 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 16 % of the base) suggests about 14–15 carbons. The formula C₁₄H₁₈O₃ matches the neutral mass (exact mass 234.1256 Da, within a few mDa) and predicts an M+1 intensity (~15.8 %) consistent with the observed spectrum. Therefore the most plausible molecular formula is C14H18O3.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H18O3</final_answer>
